teacher_fix.reason: The native one-token fused attention kernel was traced by MLX differentiation when computing the frozen parent KL target. It does not provide the log-sum-exp required by the backward pass. Materialize the identical original parent forward distribution before entering the differentiated student loss. Preserve all 1,134 previously extracted native arrays and their hash index, unchanged source material, labels, schedules, model and cost accounting. No completed optimizer checkpoint or held predictions existed before the fix.

inventory.question: Can an additional learned content read at each recurrent visit distinguish the quantities and facts relevant to the current request?

bounded_calculator_audit.method: Descriptive analysis after unmasking. Replay every observed call including errors. Count presence of all reference numerical magnitudes in the last successful call, allowing literal decimal or rational spellings. This is permissive: matching the digits does not establish the correct row, role, sign or operation. Check the last returned value separately using the registered tolerance.

panel.description: 96 exact openings and 96 reference answers. All 48 report programs were executed. Both a valid program with the wrong delivered quantity and the correct quantity without a call failed each report test. Complete normalized reference text was required for reading. 24 independent report issuers; 22 were represented by other pages in earlier project panels.

quality.method: Retrospective two-domain analysis. For each presentation require a correct delivered conclusion with adequate source support and no unsupported additions. Explicit tool execution is reported separately. Average the three presentations within each original source, then sources within each domain, then weight the two observed domains equally. Resample complete paired sources within each domain 20000 times. Measures this fixed cohort and one reviewer's judgments. Do not substitute scores from another checkpoint or impute unobserved capabilities.
